posts.cooked:
Well, we’ve got an update on what the (presumably) final stretch rewards are. The Infinitely Awesome comic for the Freedom Four, and after that, a brand new villain.

Interestingly enough, this villain is said to be a nemesis of one of the core Sentinels characters. One issue some people had with Unity (at the possibility of her being Omnitron’s nemesis) was that players that didn’t get the chance to pick her up would feel as if they had an incomplete set, as one villain would remain nemesis-less. Should we anticipate another promo hero deck in a future installment? Or is this promo villain a potential second nemesis to one of our heroes?

If he is a new nemesis for someone currently lacking, than I believe Bunker, Absolute Zero, Visionary, and Haka are all that remain, and from them, Haka fits the theme of the expansion the best. He was killed by one of his tribesmen, but came back in dandy shape to reclaim what was his, only to be turned away, being dead and all. He had to have seen something in the limbo-world that could stand alongside a group of ancient deities, what may or may not be a fallen angel, the very chaos of nature itself, and…a flaming skull-face.

Hmm…hum, hum-hum, indeed.
